prompt: Pipe A on its own can fill a tank in 6 hours. Pipe B on its own can fill the same tank in 4 hours. With both pipes running together, how long does the tank take to fill?
explanation: In one hour A fills 1/6 of the tank and B fills 1/4, so together they fill 1/6 + 1/4 = 5/12 per hour. The whole tank takes 12/5 hours, which is 2.4 hours, or 2 hours 24 minutes.
